title: Company profile
description: Four-page company profile: who we are, services, how we work, why clients stay, and contact details.
tags: company profile about us introduction presentation marketing
html:
Company profile

Property, treated like a business

SWK Properties UAE · Dubai. Sales, leasing, property management and advisory.

Who we are

{{company.name}} is a Dubai real estate brokerage serving buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants — residential, commercial and off-plan — with verified inventory and clear mandates.

We publish every listing with evidence, record what is promised, and put one named agent on every client. Our viewings, offers and transactions run on one system, so nothing is left informal.

What we do

Residential sales

Valuation, listing, marketing, viewings, offers and handover with DLD process management.

Leasing

Tenancy sourcing, renewals, Ejari registration, collections and move-in inspections.

Property management

Rent collection, arrears control, maintenance supervision and owner statements.

Off-plan

Developer and project advisory with payment-plan comparison and escrow review.

Valuation & advisory

Market opinion with comparable evidence — price, rent and yield analysis by community.

Marketing factory

Photography, portal publication with permits, and campaign reporting that follows revenue.

How an engagement works

1. Brief. We capture requirements, financing and timeline — in writing.
2. Mandate. Authority and scope agreed; permits checked before publication.
3. Marketing & viewings. Curated shortlists and reported feedback after every viewing.
4. Offer & contract. Negotiated on paper; every revision retained.
5. Transaction. Deposits, NOC, transfer and Ejari tracked with official receipts.
6. Aftercare. Commission reconciliation, renewal reminders, maintenance if we manage the unit.

Why clients stay with us

  • One agent per account, reachable by phone, WhatsApp and e-mail.
  • Plain answers. If a price must change or a lender asks for more, you hear it early with options.
  • Evidence-based pricing. Comparable sales and rent reports sit behind every recommendation.
  • Demand and consent observed: messaging, portals and campaigns run by your permission.
  • Where your property sits in our reports always explicit: market fact, forecast or estimate.

Buyer guide

From your shortlist to your keys

The process, the costs and the decisions to make early.

The path

1. Shortlist. Verified listings, comparable evidence, and viewing schedule.
2. Offer. On paper with payment method, deposit and validity.
3. Deposit & contract. Form F / MOU with the deposit cheque (usually 10%).
4. Mortgage & NOC. Bank valuation and approval; developer NOC for the transfer.
5. Transfer at DLD. Manager cheque or escrow; fees paid at the appointment.
6. Handover. Title deed, keys, meter readings, snagging (new build).

html:
Landlord guide

A tenancy you do not have to chase

Prepare, price, lease — and manage the money properly.

Pricing your unit

We price with comparable evidence from recent actual lets (not asking prices alone) and present the range with the trade-offs between rent level, vacancy and tenant quality. AED [target] is a decision, not a hope.

Preparing to lease

1. Read it like a tenant. Fix visible defects; service AC; touch up paint.
2. Papers ready. Title deed copy · DEWA / chiller certificate · photos with a permit.
3. Terms decided. Rent target, number of cheques accepted, deposit, agent fee (what's renewable).
4. Tenant selection. Verified income / bank reference · Emirates ID · reasonable history; screening with consent and equal treatment.
5. Contract & Ejari. Tenancy contract signed; Ejari registered; handover with meter photos.
6. Collections & renewals. Schedule tracked; renewals opened 90 days out.

What we handle, if you delegate

Rent chase-up, arrears routine with notices on schedule, maintenance supervision with approvals, annual inspection, and a monthly owner statement with the standing balance held on your behalf.
